method: Read-only comparison of existing parent-executed native fixture reports, saved OCR checkpoints, frozen source and installed modules; no GUI/model reruns
scope: FINAL10 Blender menu fixture setup failure diagnosis only
instrumented_changes: Import path for existing public fixture helper
Extra native PointerInput(move) before unchanged click
Screenshot and OCR before/after move, after click and after Escape
rejected_hypothesis: Parent-confirmed popup was closed after Escape and before/after the separate move; Edit popup opened only after click. Hover-then-click-close is rejected for the instrumented observed sequence.

native_semantics.pointer_click_sequence: Move; fresh guard; native button down; post guard; finally release newly owned input
native_semantics.x11_backend: PyAutoGUI XTest motion, press and release each synchronize with X server; server request acknowledgement does not establish Blender event processing or widget effect
native_semantics.pointer_delivery_receipt: InputDelivery receipts are generated for key/chord triggers; pointer path has no receipt
native_semantics.fixture_setup_results: Canonical click and Escape ActionResult values are ignored; setup dispatches are absent from operation/terminal runtime log
native_semantics.application_effect: Menu provider uses actual screenshot OCR; returning ABSENT with absent popup is correct

unobserved_boundary: Canonical Edit setup input admission/result and actual Motion/ButtonPress/ButtonRelease delivery/order/timing versus Blender menu activation, before read-only assessment
causal_limit: Instrumented success changes motion count, elapsed pre-click processing opportunity, and extra captures simultaneously; it does not isolate which change affected the outcome
actionable_fixture_followup: Record and check each setup ActionResult, record native event/ACK metadata, and verify the intended menu preparation postcondition before assigning expected assessment; preserve canonical failure. No blind retry, arbitrary sleep, runtime guard weakening or threshold change is justified by present evidence.
